acquisition method: In the data-dependent acquisition mode, the MS data were acquired at a high resolution of 60,000 (m/z 200) across a mass range of 350–1500 m/z.
alkylation reagent: alkylation (40 mM iodoacetamide in 25 mM NH4HCO3 for 45 min at RT in the dark)
alkylation concentration: alkylation (40 mM iodoacetamide in 25 mM NH4HCO3 for 45 min at RT in the dark)
cleavage agent: digested with trypsin in 25 mM NH4HCO3 overnight at 37 °C to allow complete digestion.
collision energy: fragmentation in the Ion Routing Multipole with normalized collision energy of 28%.
enrichment method: Cell lysates were incubated with anti-FLAG M2 affinity gel (Sigma) at 4 °C overnight.
fractionation method: the interacting proteins were captured by co-IP and separated by nonreducing versus reducing 2-D gel.
instrument: The eluate was electrosprayed at a 2.0 kV voltage directly into an Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
ionization type: The eluate was electrosprayed at a 2.0 kV voltage directly into an Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer
labeling: protein interaction was defined as significant if abundance ratio of ORF8-overexpressing group to control group is ≥ 3
reduction reagent: reduction (10 mM DTT in 25 mM NH4HCO3 for 45 min at 56 °C)
reduction concentration: reduction (10 mM DTT in 25 mM NH4HCO3 for 45 min at 56 °C)
